item.title: Can a positive Bloom filter result reject a username?
item.description: Use expected-count tables and a deterministic collision model to decide when probabilistic positives need authoritative verification.

item.title: Why does nth-child striping break after rows are hidden?
item.description: Hidden rows can remain in structural indexing. A complete four-row fixture compares external filtering with nth-child’s of subset, including exact memberships, state changes and unsupported syntax.

item.title: Cleanup ran, so why does the old widget still receive events?
item.description: Listener removal requires the correct target, event type, callback identity and capture value. A complete counting probe distinguishes mismatches and signal cleanup across remounts.

item.title: Why does another listener on the same button survive stopPropagation?
item.description: The current same-target listener sequence differs from later propagation. Three expected custom-event traces separate immediate stopping, cancellation and completed side effects.

item.title: Stop when p drops below .05: what happened to the original guarantee?
item.description: A single-look cutoff does not automatically control stopping at any significant look. An exact two-look teaching example distinguishes fixed horizons, sequential inference and safety stops.

item.title: Conversion rose, but why did a 50/50 test become 60/40?
item.description: When analyzed group counts disagree with planned allocation, reconcile assignment, exposure and inclusion before interpreting lift. A hypothetical ledger separates SRM detection, diagnosis and the benefit decision.

item.title: A Go parent test function can return before its test tree finishes
item.description: Distinguish parent-function return from test-tree completion with complete expected-failure and expected-success controls, including Setenv’s process-wide limit.

item.title: Why can a preview escape while its iframe still has sandbox?
item.description: An unexecuted two-file fixture compares same-origin iframe permissions, sandbox removal, navigation timing and dedicated hosting for untrusted HTML.

item.title: Why did JSON Patch delete B and E when B and D were selected?
item.description: Trace positional deletion on a five-item list and distinguish descending indices, tests, version conditions and stable identity.

item.title: After rotation leaves an empty log, check which file the writer still holds
item.description: Use a local file-sequence exercise to explain retained writers and the copytruncate loss window, without presenting it as a real logrotate run.

item.title: Why revoke the new refresh token when the old one is already invalid?
item.description: Separate old-token rejection from active-token revocation with a three-step state exercise, including concurrent refresh, lost responses and access-token limits.

item.title: A removed set member returns: should a concurrent add win?
item.description: Trace two addition identities in a complete teaching model and distinguish shared-label convergence from revocation policy.

item.title: Does a vanished collation warning mean old indexes are repaired?
item.description: Use a two-index ledger and read-only catalog queries to distinguish a vanished warning, restored dependencies and workload validation.

item.title: Why can SELECT still read old prices after a write CTE?
item.description: Use complete temporary-table SQL to compare old base values, new returned values and audit inputs, including overlapping-write limits.

item.title: Why did setting quota to zero have no effect? Check Protobuf presence
item.description: Compare explicit presence, implicit merging and older reserialization across unchanged, zero and nonzero quota updates.

item.title: Why does a React editor keep the previous record’s draft?
item.description: Changing record props need not reset an editor at the same tree position. A complete editor and A/B/A expectations explain keyed subtree recreation, draft retention and separate backend work.

item.title: An expired start-limit window does not schedule a systemd retry
item.description: Explain restart policy, start-rate limits and new triggers with a bounded three-start unit, separating counter reset, process launch and business readiness.

item.title: Connect HTTP 425 to business side effects before enabling TLS 0-RTT
item.description: Connect TLS early-data rejection, HTTP 425 retry conditions and independent business-state readings. The POST ledger is an isolated negative rejection test.

item.title: Was the new design faster, or had users just learned the task?
item.description: Faster second attempts may reflect learning rather than a better interface. A four-sequence plan for two designs and two materials makes order checkable and identifies when separate participants are preferable.

item.title: 把资源身份与访问URL分开，接口换版本时少一份歧义
item.description: 按Google AIP-122区分局部ID、相对和完整资源名及访问URI，用父级冲突、版本映射与调用者别名说明长期引用应携带的范围。

item.title: 让迟到数据改报表之前，先约定累积结果还是增量
item.description: 以Apache Beam事件时间窗口的五、十二和错误十七演算迟到修订，区分累积替换与增量叠加，说明触发、保留、定稿和补记的边界。

item.title: 晚开的标签页，为什么收不到先前的BroadcastChannel消息？
item.description: 从发送时的接收者选择解释晚加入不重放、发送对象不自回声，并用两页教学示例区分通知与当前状态来源。

item.title: 为帮助中心选开放、封闭还是混合卡片分类
item.description: 用六张帮助内容卡说明三种分类方法怎样改变证据，并把分组分歧交给后续寻找任务验证。

item.title: CONFIGURE_DEPENDS 解决重查，不替代源码清单的取舍
item.description: 对照显式列表、普通 GLOB 和带 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS 的列表，确认新增源码如何进入构建图，并保留生成器支持与成员误匹配的取舍。

item.title: 用 order-only 让目录先建好，保留文件的增量判断
item.description: 目录先存在，与目录变新后重建，是两项不同要求。用完整规则对照普通前提和 order-only，检查真实输入更新仍然有效。

item.title: Iceberg最新快照不用的文件，为什么还不能删除？
item.description: 用共享文件的两快照引用图区分Iceberg快照过期和孤儿清理，解释历史回溯、在途写入与路径表示对删除选择的影响。

item.title: 为事件调查和采集排障分别选日志时间
item.description: Timestamp 与 ObservedTimestamp 分别属于源事件和采集观察。三条完整记录说明单时间出口的选择、缺失来源和跨时钟差值边界。

item.title: 把PostgreSQL逻辑迁移验收拆成行、结构和下一次写入
item.description: PostgreSQL 18逻辑订阅追平不涵盖DDL、序列状态与大对象。用完整只读盘点和独立数值对照划清读副本与写入切换的验收条件。

item.title: PromQL 算出 0，告警为什么仍然 active？
item.description: PromQL 的 bool 比较保留零值元素，告警则按结果元素的存在性激活。用两个目标比较三份表达式，分清过滤、等待和缺失。

item.title: autospec 还没调用业务，为什么真实 property 已经执行？
item.description: autospec 建立规格时可能读取真实属性。用本地异常哨兵和窄接口对照，区分内省、签名约束与真实业务验证。

item.title: 小规模试发问卷，不能替代认知预试
item.description: 借一份五笔合成台账比较认知追问与现场试发的证据，区分答案完整、理解一致与实际资料可得。

item.title: RabbitMQ已ACK，消息为什么没有进入队列？
item.description: 按RabbitMQ 4.1的AMQP 0-9-1合同区分不可路由退回、发布确认与结果未知，用完整本地轨迹说明为什么后到的ACK不能覆盖return。

item.title: 缓存和业务真相共用Redis前，先安排内存耗尽的结果
item.description: 从Redis内存耗尽时的驱逐或拒写结果选择缓存与业务权威的放置，比较allkeys、volatile、noeviction的候选范围及可观察证据。

item.title: 给Saga安排补偿结果，而不只画一条失败箭头
item.description: 以预留确认、付款拒绝和释放超时的Saga轨迹定义补偿未知、查询确认及人工处理，明确补偿是新的业务动作而非跨服务回滚。

item.title: 为离线包设计容量提示，而不是写入保证
item.description: 用只读函数和四组独立预期区分容量估值、本次写入与持久权限，处理等号边界和预检后失败。

item.title: ExecCondition 返回 1，systemd 为什么没把服务判失败？
item.description: ExecCondition 的默认退出范围区分继续、跳过和失败。用完整教学单元核对三种结果，并保留 SuccessExitStatus 与 ExecStopPost 的影响。

item.title: 保留姓名原文，单独定义Unicode比较键
item.description: 保留原始姓名并生成NFC比较键，用五项独立预期解释兼容合并、碰撞处理与拼接后再次归一化。

item.title: 用一段培训录像规划对白、说话者与提示音字幕
item.description: 用八秒合成脚本和三条字幕预期，检查对白、角色与错误提示音，并区分文字稿、字幕与文字替代例外。

item.title: Tab只缩进不离开：编辑器怎样给键盘用户出口？
item.description: 以接管Tab的内联编辑区和完整本地页面，定义Escape交接、后续导航、模式拦截及真实键盘验收范围。

item.title: Separate resource identity from its access URL
item.description: Distinguish local IDs, relative and full resource names, and access URIs under Google AIP-122, using parent collisions, declared version mappings and caller-dependent aliases.

item.title: Before applying late data, choose replacement totals or deltas
item.description: Work through five, twelve and an incorrect seventeen to define late-data corrections in Apache Beam event-time windows, separating replacement totals, additive contributions and audited backfills.

item.title: Why does a newly opened tab miss an earlier BroadcastChannel message?
item.description: Explain late subscription and sender exclusion through the recipient-selection algorithm, then separate change notifications from the source of current state.

item.title: Choosing open, closed or hybrid sorting for a help centre
item.description: Use six help-content cards to compare the evidence from open, closed and hybrid sorts, then carry disputed groupings into finding tasks.

item.title: CONFIGURE_DEPENDS adds rechecks without removing the source-list tradeoff
item.description: Compare explicit lists, plain GLOB and CONFIGURE_DEPENDS to inspect new-source membership, generator support and unintended matches.

item.title: Use order-only prerequisites to create directories without invalidating files
item.description: Directory preparation and target invalidation are separate requirements. Compare complete rules while checking that real input updates still rebuild the report.

item.title: Why an Iceberg file absent from the latest snapshot may still be needed
item.description: Use a two-snapshot reference graph to distinguish Iceberg snapshot expiration from orphan removal, accounting for retained history, active writers and path representations.

item.title: Choose log timestamps separately for incident and collection questions
item.description: Timestamp and ObservedTimestamp describe source events and collection observations. Three complete records show fallback selection, missing provenance and clock-difference limits.

item.title: Validate logical migration through rows, schema, and the next write
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 logical replication does not cover DDL, sequence state or large objects. A complete read-only inventory and independent numeric cases separate read-subscriber evidence from write-cutover readiness.

item.title: Why can a PromQL result of zero still activate an alert?
item.description: Bool comparisons retain zero-valued elements, while alerts activate by result presence. Two targets distinguish filtering, waiting periods and missing data.

item.title: Why can autospec execute a real property before the test calls it?
item.description: Autospec can read real attributes while constructing a spec. A local sentinel and a narrow interface distinguish inspection, signature checks and real behavior.

item.title: A pilot survey does not replace cognitive pretesting
item.description: Use five synthetic ledger entries to compare cognitive probes and a field pilot, separating complete answers from shared meaning and record availability.

item.title: RabbitMQ acknowledged the publish. Why is the queue empty?
item.description: Separate unroutable returns, publisher confirms and unknown outcomes under RabbitMQ 4.1 AMQP 0-9-1, using complete local traces that preserve a return after a later ACK.

item.title: Choose the out-of-memory outcome before mixing cache and authoritative state
item.description: Choose where Redis caches and authoritative records belong by their eviction or write-rejection consequences, with explicit allkeys, volatile and noeviction eligibility examples.

item.title: Record Saga compensation outcomes beyond the failure arrow
item.description: Define uncertain compensation, authoritative lookup and manual intervention through Saga traces involving a confirmed reservation, rejected payment and timed-out release.

item.title: Design an advisory capacity check for an offline package
item.description: Use a read-only classifier and four independent expected cases to separate estimated capacity, actual writes and persistence permission.

item.title: Why does ExecCondition exit 1 skip a service without marking it failed?
item.description: ExecCondition distinguishes continuing, skipping and failure. A complete teaching unit retains the effects of SuccessExitStatus and ExecStopPost.

item.title: Preserve the name and define its Unicode comparison key separately
item.description: Preserve original names and derive NFC comparison keys, using five independent expectations to examine compatibility folding, collisions and concatenation.

item.title: Plan captions for speech, speakers and meaningful sounds
item.description: Use an eight-second synthetic script and three expected cues to review speech, speakers, an error tone and the text-alternative exception.

item.title: Tab only indents. How can a keyboard user leave the editor?
item.description: Use a complete local inline-editor fixture to define an Escape handoff, subsequent navigation and the limits of keyboard-exit validation.
